text: Sorry if this is a daft one. I'm minding my grandson tonight, he's 6 months old, and his temperature is 38. He's been snuffly all day, nose running then blocked, and sneezing a fair bit. He's also got a really sore red nappy rash, poor lamb, it looks angry. His mum said not to fuss but I thought I'd better check with someone rather than sit here worrying. Is 38 something to act on at his age or do I just keep an eye?
